outcome.understand.clarificationBody: Your answer is recorded in the contract exactly as shown here.
outcome.understand.persistedNote: Every revision stays immutable and readable from the daemon.
outcome.understand.clarificationLocalDay: This Mac's local calendar day, resetting at local midnight
outcome.understand.immutableNote: Each save creates a new immutable revision.
outcome.understand.heading: State this Outcome
outcome.understand.conflictBody: Expected revision {{expected}}, but the current revision is {{current}}. Load the current contract to continue from it.
outcome.understand.retryableTitle: The daemon could not save the contract
outcome.understand.clarificationRolling: A rolling 24-hour window before each entry
outcome.decide.heading: Decide & authorize
outcome.decide.intro: Review exactly what the agent may do before anything runs. Nothing executes until you approve it.
outcome.decide.proposeBody: Waldo proposes WorkUnits and dependencies against your saved Contract. Review the proposal before authorizing execution.
outcome.decide.approveNote: Approval activates these capability grants only inside this outcome's isolated worktree. Execution starts in the next stage.
outcome.decide.reviewWorkNote: Opens this Outcome's Act & Observe board, where you can start (or continue) the governed attempt.
outcome.decide.staleBody: This plan binds an older revision. Reload the current facts, then draft a fresh plan.
outcome.decide.blockedTitle: Not every capability is available here
outcome.decide.bindingNote: Frozen against contract revision {{contractRevision}}. Any material change requires a fresh plan.
outcome.run.heading: Act & observe
outcome.run.intro: One governed attempt at a time. Kennel shows the truthful state — waiting, working, unconfirmed, or ended — and completion is never treated as done.
outcome.run.needsPlanBody: Authorize a plan in Decide & Authorize first. Execution only ever starts from an approved plan.
outcome.run.startBody: Starting admits your approved plan onto a real provider session inside this outcome's isolated worktree. The attempt, its session identity, and every observation are recorded.
outcome.run.unconfirmedBody: The bound session has not proven it is alive. This is not declared dead — contain it, then reconcile before any replacement so duplicate effects stay impossible.
outcome.run.ownerStopBody: Kennel cannot prove whether the provider is still running. Continue only if YOU verified outside Kennel — process list, terminal, provider dashboard — that nothing is running. This releases custody on your word, records your assertion in the attempt history, and allows a replacement attempt.
outcome.run.ownerStopAssertCta: I verified it is stopped — release custody
outcome.run.waitingBody: Working — nothing needs you right now. Observations are recorded as they arrive.
outcome.run.unclassifiedBody: The provider session ended. Completion is not final acceptance — classification happens through Verification.
outcome.run.actionRequiredBody: This attempt could not be proven alive or ended in failure. Replace it with a fresh attempt; local work stays retained until explicit cleanup.
outcome.run.panelFallbackBody: Kennel doesn't have a live terminal for this attempt yet. This panel will show the real provider session once one is bound.
outcome.run.panelEndedUnclassified: This Attempt ended before Kennel could classify the outcome. The recorded facts below are everything the daemon kept.
outcome.run.panelFallbackUnavailableBody: This Attempt was bound to a provider session, but that session record is no longer available in this workspace. The Attempt facts shown here are everything the daemon kept.
outcome.run.waitingInputBody: The provider asked for input — respond to its question in its session.
outcome.run.blockedBody: A permission/approval dialog blocks the provider — approve or deny it in its session.
outcome.run.cancelledBody: Cancellation is recorded and the bound session was stopped through the execution seam. Reconcile to confirm the stop and release custody before any replacement.
outcome.understand.clarificationTitle: One material question: what does “today” mean?
outcome.understand.constraintPlaceholder: A boundary the work must respect
outcome.understand.goalPlaceholder: What state does this Outcome pursue?
work.enter.pickProjectHint: Select a project to state its first Outcome.
outcome.understand.intro: Goal, success criteria, and review are recorded as an immutable contract. Nothing is saved until the daemon confirms it.
outcome.understand.reviewPlaceholder: How the result will be reviewed before acceptance
outcome.understand.criterionPlaceholder: Observable result that proves part of the goal
outcome.understand.offlineBody: Nothing was saved. Check that the daemon is running, then retry.

outcome.proof.decisionSummary: What did you decide, and why?
outcome.proof.changesMore: The full change list is retained; only the first entries are shown
outcome.run.proofBody: Attempt completion is only a fact. Bind inspectable evidence to every criterion, record the real verification method, then make the owner decision.

outcome.intake.reviewBody: Nothing becomes an Outcome until you confirm.
outcome.intake.authorityBody: Choose what this Outcome may do. These permissions apply when you confirm; confirming does not start work.
outcome.intake.section.criteriaHint: Each criterion states one thing that must be true, and the evidence that would show it.
outcome.intake.section.boundsHint: Constraints limit how the work is done. Non-goals are explicitly out of scope. Stop conditions end the work rather than shape it.
outcome.intake.section.facetsHint: What sort of work this is, and anything that kind specifically requires.

outcome.intake.waiting.releaseReason: Released while waiting for an agent to propose a Contract.
outcome.intake.waiting.offlineHint: The offline proposal is always available. Nothing is lost by not waiting — you edit every field before confirming either way.

mission.delivery.heading: Deliver reviewed result
mission.delivery.intro: Delivery copies one exact retained artifact to a destination you choose. It never accepts the Outcome or publishes it.
mission.delivery.exactArtifact: Enter the exact Attempt and artifact version to deliver. Kennel will refuse a mismatched or incomplete artifact.
mission.delivery.acceptedAvailable: Accepted delivery is available because this Outcome has an explicit acceptance decision.
mission.delivery.acceptedUnavailable: Accepted delivery stays unavailable until you explicitly accept the Outcome. Draft delivery remains distinct.
mission.delivery.waitingForEligibility: Reading whether the daemon can accept a delivery request…
mission.delivery.boundary: A successful or recovered delivery proves only that bytes were transferred or found at the destination; it does not infer acceptance.
mission.delivery.empty: No delivery has been requested for this Outcome.
mission.delivery.recovered: Recovered by inspecting the destination; completion was not watched live.
mission.delivery.observed: Completed while Kennel observed the transfer.
mission.delivery.chooseDifferentDestinat: Choose a different destination before retrying; Kennel found other content there.
mission.delivery.unreadable: The destination could not be read confidently. Do not treat this as a successful transfer.
mission.delivery.reproduce: The retained artifact is unavailable. Reproduce or retain it before requesting delivery again.
mission.delivery.pendingNoRetry: This delivery is still pending. Wait for its durable status; do not create a duplicate retry.
mission.delivery.reason.delivery_artifac: the exact artifact identity does not match
mission.delivery.reason.delivery_recover: the destination could not be read

outcome.plan.invalidCheck: The proposed plan contains a check Kennel cannot safely run. No plan was saved. Retry to draft a corrected plan.

deletion.title: Delete Outcome
deletion.description: Move to Trash to restore it later, or delete it permanently.
deletion.blockers: Stop or reconcile this work first

deletion.warning: Permanently deletes this Outcome and its saved history. This cannot be undone.
deletion.trashDescription: Restore an Outcome or permanently remove its owned history.
deletion.preserved: Your imported project and exported files stay untouched.
deletion.retainedDetails: Permanent deletion removes owned sessions, clean workspaces and saved evidence. Shared or unresolved work blocks cleanup. Provider history, logs and backups are preserved.
